description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Year's Truce--1609" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This book details the intricate and tumultuous events surrounding the establishment and persistence of the Dutch Republic amid its prolonged struggle for independence from Spain.
